core_MS.idea: the Sequence pusher: pushing the crate also advances the pusher's arrow - who must leave before the crate moves, and who only after

core_MF.idea: push, then be turned around: a flip target clears a lane by pushing the crate, and can only leave once the switch reverses it - the switch must not go first

core_PR.idea: lanes that bend: a block's way out runs through the portal and is blocked far from where it starts

core_PG.idea: the gate's key leaves through the portal: its exit lane on the far side must be cleared first

core_MG.idea: the pull decides who is in the way: the magnet drags a plain block into a lane another block still needs

core_SG.idea: two stages: a gate opens only when its keys are gone, and the switch that turns the keys around must fire between them

core_LS.idea: the key must turn before it can leave: a Sequence block is the only red key - its advance changes which lane it needs

core_AR.idea: one rammer, several shells: which shell to crack first, and who must still be there to crack the next

core_PM.idea: the crate goes through the portal: a push sends it to the far side of the board, where it blocks a different lane - who must leave before, and who can only leave after

core_LS2.idea: the key is turned by a switch: the red key can only leave after the switch reverses it, and the switch also turns other blocks - when to fire it

core_AR2.idea: the magnet brings the rammer: a pull moves a block into the lane of a shell - or into a lane where it is only in the way

core_PS.idea: reversed through the portal: a flipped block's new lane runs through the portal to the far side - fire the switch before or after that side is clear

core_MX1.idea: pull, then turn: the magnet drags a block across the board while the switch reverses others - a pulled block can land in a lane the switch has just turned toward it

core_MX2.idea: two switches, one crate: each switch reverses its own blocks; one reversal must wait for a push, the other must come before a block is boxed in

core_MX3.idea: keys on the move: two magnets drag the keys of a lock around the board - pulled early, a key blocks the lane it was meant to open

core_SPC.idea: push before you turn: a spinner must launch the crate out of a lane before a neighbour's departure turns it away - and the crate's new cell must not be in anyone's way

core_SPP.idea: a turn that changes the far side: a spinner's lane runs through the portal in one facing and straight out in another
